evidence.title: Technical data sheet - TL-5 tank sealing compound
evidence.claim: The MDI prepolymer addition rate is restricted to manage the exothermic reaction (2021).
evidence.quote: MDI prepolymer addition rate is limited to control the exotherm.

evidence.title: Incident report IR-2005-011
evidence.claim: In 2005, humid air entering the tank during isocyanate addition caused a reaction producing CO2, leading to a can lid blowing off.
evidence.quote: humid summer air was drawn into the D-4 headspace during the isocyanate addition; the water reacted with isocyanate

evidence.title: Change request CR-2005-009
evidence.claim: In 2005, a nitrogen blanket was added to tank D-4 to prevent pressure build-up caused by moisture ingress during isocyanate addition.
evidence.quote: Reason: IR-2005-011 (pressure build-up in cans from moisture ingress).

evidence.title: Commissioning record EQ-2013-004 - vacuum dryer VD-1
evidence.claim: In 2013, vacuum dryer VD-1 was commissioned to ensure polyol water content is below 0.05% before isocyanate addition for TL-5.
evidence.quote: Vacuum dryer VD-1 for polyol: drying at 90 °C / 20 mbar to water below 0.05 %

evidence.title: DEVIATION REPORT DR-2001-019
evidence.claim: In 2001, high water content in polyol PS-400 caused CO2 formation and bulging cans for product TL-5.
evidence.quote: cans bulging at a customer (domed lids). Carbon dioxide formed by the reaction of isocyanate with water

evidence.title: Laboratory report LT-2018-022 - water content of TL-5
evidence.claim: In 2018, the vacuum dryer VD-1 successfully maintained water content in TL-5 batches between 0.012% and 0.028%.
evidence.quote: Karl Fischer water of 30 TL-5 batches after VD-1 drying: 0.012-0.028 %.

evidence.title: Supplier qualification SQ-2016-005 - Nordpol Chemicals AB, NP-310 Dry
evidence.claim: In 2016, Nordpol Chemicals NP-310 Dry replaced Polioli Sereni PS-400 for TL-5, guaranteeing maximum water content of 0.03%.
evidence.quote: Polyether polyol NP-310 Dry: water 0.03 % maximum guaranteed, delivered in nitrogen-padded tank trucks. Replaces Polioli Sereni PS-400 for TL-5.

evidence.title: FATTURA / INVOICE n. 7620/25
evidence.claim: The plant was still purchasing NP-310 Dry polyol from Nordpol Chemicals in October 2025.
evidence.quote: Item: Polyol NP-310 Dry, tank truck. Quantity: 400 kg.

evidence.title: CHANGE REQUEST CR-2001-014
evidence.claim: In 2001, molecular sieves were added to TL-5 to absorb water from PS-400 until the supplier could guarantee 0.05% or less.
evidence.quote: add 2 kg molecular sieve 3A per batch to absorb residual water from polyol PS-400.

verdict.process_name: TL-5 tank sealing compound (1K moisture-cure polyurethane)
verdict.instruction: Add 280 kg MDI prepolymer (RM-410) at max. 2 kg/min.
verdict.reason: The addition rate is restricted to control the exothermic reaction (E3). Previous incidents of CO2 formation and pressure build-up occurred due to moisture reacting with isocyanate (E4, E7), making the controlled addition a safety/quality measure to manage the reaction hazard, which remains a characteristic of the chemistry.

chain.claim: The MDI prepolymer addition rate is limited to control the exotherm

counter_evidence.claim: Water content is now strictly controlled via NP-310 Dry polyol and vacuum dryer VD-1
counter_evidence.resolution: While moisture is reduced, the addition rate specifically manages the exotherm (E3), which is distinct from the moisture-driven CO2 pressure issues (E4, E7).
